data.narrative:
Onebrief is a Series D defense and security company founded by Grant Demaree and Rafa Pereira, currently valued at $2.15B post-money on $336M raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Helsing, Saronic, Chaos Industries, Anduril Industries, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.5x step-up multiplier from the last post-money valuation of $2.1B, yielding $3.2B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables produces $9.2B, derived from Helsing at $18.0B, Saronic at $9.2B, and Chaos Industries at $4.5B. The peer range spans $4.5B to $18.0B, reflecting material dispersion in defense tech valuations at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $2.7B to $10.6B, with a median of $6.2B. This range reflects tension between stage-progression fundamentals and peer multiples. Key uncertainties include company-specific revenue, growth rate, and profitability relative to peers; the wide peer range ($4.5B–$18.0B) itself signals heterogeneity in market assessment of defense tech risk and defensibility. Validation would benefit from revenue multiples and customer concentration data relative to the comp set.
